description: The Zambezi River Authority, set up in 1987 by Zambia and Zimbabwe, publishes hydrological data for the Kariba reservoir on its website. The lake levels page gives Lake Kariba weekly levels with daily values for the latest two weeks and the same dates a year earlier, with the percentage of usable storage, and notes that the lake is designed to operate between 475.50 m and 488.50 m for hydropower. The Kariba reservoir data page tables daily lake level, percent full, live storage, turbine discharge, spillage and total outflow for three years side by side. The river flows page describes a network of thirteen stations with daily levels, eight with flow measurement including Victoria Falls, and tables daily flows at selected stations such as Chavuma. Coverage is the Kariba reservoir and upstream Zambezi stations. Access is free online as HTML tables. Caveats: only recent windows are shown and no downloadable archive or licence was found. Simulation uses: reservoir and hydropower operation, drought assessment and inflow forecasting. Related records: GRanD (data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database) and the Global Dam Tracker (data-gdat-global-dam-tracker).
